mapper.select: WITH f AS ( SELECT a.tablespace_name, ROUND(SUM(a.bytes)/1073741824,2) AS free_gb FROM dba_free_space a JOIN dba_users b ON a.tablespace_name=b.default_tablespace WHERE b.username=USER GROUP BY a.tablespace_name), t AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(a.bytes)/1073741824,2) AS total_gb FROM dba_data_files a JOIN dba_users b ON a.tablespace_name=b.default_tablespace WHERE b.username=USER) SELECT TRIM(f.tablespace_name) AS tablespace_name, ROUND(t.total_gb-f.free_gb,2) AS used_gb, t.total_gb, f.free_gb, ROUND(((t.total_gb-f.free_gb)/t.total_gb)*100,2) AS pct FROM f, t
SELECT NULL AS TABLESPACE_NAME, NULL AS USED_GB, NULL AS TOTAL_GB, NULL AS FREE_GB, NULL AS PCT WHERE FALSE
